_comment: Example provenance record for one source-training run (baseline_yolo26m_bf_seed42, the seed-42 YOLO26m source-domain baseline), consolidated for release from the files every source-training run writes (args.yaml, split_manifest.json, system_info.txt, pip_freeze.txt, metrics_summary.json); fine-tuning runs record their arguments (args.yaml) and per-epoch and final metrics. Absolute machine paths and the hostname have been redacted to placeholders; all hyperparameters, the seed, environment identification, and final aggregate metrics are the real recorded values. The per-run files for all runs are available from the corresponding author on reasonable academic request together with the training code.

environment.pip_freeze: pip_freeze.txt (full environment snapshot serialized alongside this record)

metrics._note: Final aggregate source-domain validation metrics. Per-epoch metrics are recorded in results.csv (not reproduced here).
